title: Everyday verbs and time
focus: 去 来 看 说 想 要 会 能 知道 喜欢; time words 今天 明天 昨天 现在 时候 早上 晚上.
body:
# Everyday verbs and time

These verbs carry most of what you say in a day: going, coming, seeing, saying, wanting. Time words usually come near the front of a sentence, before or right after the person: 我明天去 or 明天我去.

Most time words have 日 (sun) in them, which makes them easy to spot on a page.

| Word | Pinyin | Meaning / clue |
|---|---|---|
| 去 来 走 | qù lái zǒu | go, come, leave |
| 看 听 说 | kàn tīng shuō | look, listen, say (说 has 讠 speech) |
| 想 要 | xiǎng yào | think, would like; want (想 has 心 heart) |
| 会 能 | huì néng | can (learned skill); can (able, allowed) |
| 知道 喜欢 买 | zhīdào xǐhuan mǎi | know, like, buy |
| 今天 明天 昨天 | jīntiān míngtiān zuótiān | today, tomorrow, yesterday |
| 后天 每天 | hòutiān měitiān | day after tomorrow, every day |
| 现在 时候 | xiànzài shíhou | now; time, when |
| 早上 中午 下午 晚上 | zǎoshang zhōngwǔ xiàwǔ wǎnshang | morning, noon, afternoon, evening |

Spot the 日 sun in 明 昨 时 早 晚: they are all about time or light.

## Examples

- 我明天去。 wǒ míngtiān qù: I'll go tomorrow.
- 你来不来? nǐ lái bu lái: Are you coming or not?
- 我不知道。 wǒ bù zhīdào: I don't know.
- 他现在不在家。 tā xiànzài bú zài jiā: He's not home right now.
- 我想回家。 wǒ xiǎng huíjiā: I want to go home.
- 你能来吗? nǐ néng lái ma: Can you come?
- 他会做饭。 tā huì zuòfàn: He can cook.
- 妈妈去买菜了。 māma qù mǎi cài le: Mom went to buy groceries.
- 他昨天来了。 tā zuótiān lái le: He came yesterday.
- 今天晚上我们去吃饭。 jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen qù chīfàn: We're going out to eat tonight.
- 他来的时候,我在睡觉。 tā lái de shíhou, wǒ zài shuìjiào: When he came, I was asleep.

## Common mistakes

- **买 vs 卖.** 买 (mǎi) is buy. 卖 (mài) is sell, and has an extra 十 on top.
- **午 vs 牛.** 午 (wǔ, noon) stops at the top line. In 牛 (niú, cow) the middle stroke pokes through.
- **去 vs 云.** 去 (qù) has 土 on top; 云 (yún, cloud) has 二.

cards.Example: 你去不去? nǐ qù bu qù: Are you going or not?
cards.Notes: 去 = 土 over 厶; 去 vs 云 (yún, cloud), which has 二 on top

cards.Example: 他来了! tā lái le: He's here!
cards.Notes: 来 vs 米 (mǐ, rice): 来 has an extra line on top

cards.Example: 我看一下。 wǒ kàn yíxià: Let me take a look.
cards.Notes: A hand 手 over an eye 目: shading your eyes to look

cards.Example: 他说不去。 tā shuō bú qù: He says he's not going.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 兑 duì

cards.Meaning: to think; to want to; to miss
cards.Example: 我想回家。 wǒ xiǎng huíjiā: I want to go home.
cards.Notes: 相 xiāng for the sound + 心 heart underneath

cards.Example: 你要这个吗? nǐ yào zhège ma: Do you want this one?
cards.Notes: 覀 on top of 女; 要 vs 耍 (shuǎ, play), which has 而 on top

cards.Example: 他会做饭。 tā huì zuòfàn: He can cook.
cards.Notes: 人 roof over 云; 会 vs 去: different tops, both end in 厶

cards.Meaning: can, be able to, be allowed
cards.Example: 你能来吗? nǐ néng lái ma: Can you come?
cards.Notes: 能 vs 熊 (xióng, bear): the bear adds four dots underneath

cards.Example: 我知道了。 wǒ zhīdào le: Got it.
cards.Notes: 知 = 矢 arrow + 口; 道 has 辶 walk wrapping 首 head

cards.Example: 她喜欢吃米饭。 tā xǐhuan chī mǐfàn: She likes rice.
cards.Notes: 欢 = 又 + 欠 (open mouth); 喜 has two 口 hidden inside

cards.Example: 今天我做饭。 jīntiān wǒ zuòfàn: I'm cooking today.
cards.Notes: 今 vs 令 (lìng, order): 今 ends in a short 乛 stroke

cards.Example: 明天我不在家。 míngtiān wǒ bú zài jiā: I won't be home tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 明 = 日 sun + 月 moon: bright

cards.Example: 他昨天来了。 tā zuótiān lái le: He came yesterday.
cards.Notes: 昨 = 日 + 乍 zhà; the same 乍 is in 作 zuò and 怎 zěn

cards.Example: 我现在就去。 wǒ xiànzài jiù qù: I'm going right now.
cards.Notes: 现 = 王 jade + 见 jiàn for the sound

cards.Example: 他来的时候,我在睡觉。 tā lái de shíhou, wǒ zài shuìjiào: When he came, I was asleep.
cards.Notes: 时 = 日 + 寸; 候 vs 侯 (hóu): 候 has an extra short vertical stroke

cards.Example: 我早上不吃饭。 wǒ zǎoshang bù chīfàn: I don't eat in the morning.
cards.Notes: 早 = 日 sun over 十: the sun just up; 上 is toneless here

cards.Example: 今天晚上我们去吃饭。 jīntiān wǎnshang wǒmen qù chīfàn: We're going out to eat tonight.
cards.Notes: 晚 = 日 + 免 miǎn for the sound

cards.Example: 下午我要睡觉。 xiàwǔ wǒ yào shuìjiào: I'm taking a nap this afternoon.
cards.Notes: 午 vs 牛 (niú, cow): in 牛 the middle stroke pokes through the top

cards.Example: 中午回家吃饭。 zhōngwǔ huíjiā chīfàn: Come home for lunch.
cards.Notes: 中 is a line through the middle of a box

cards.Example: 他后天来。 tā hòutiān lái: He's coming the day after tomorrow.
cards.Notes: 后 = after, behind; its opposite is 前 (qián), as in 前天, the day before yesterday

cards.Example: 我每天都喝水。 wǒ měitiān dōu hē shuǐ: I drink water every day.
cards.Notes: 每 vs 母 (mǔ, mother): 每 adds a small 𠂉 on top

cards.Example: 我在听。 wǒ zài tīng: I'm listening.
cards.Notes: 口 mouth + 斤 jīn

cards.Example: 妈妈去买菜了。 māma qù mǎi cài le: Mom went to buy groceries.
cards.Notes: 买 vs 卖 (mài, sell): 卖 has an extra 十 on top

cards.Example: 我走了。 wǒ zǒu le: I'm off.
cards.Notes: 土 on top of a foot; it is the radical in 起 and 赶
The time word goes before the verb: 明天去, never 去明天
不 stays bù before a 1st tone (知 zhī)
在 appears twice: 现在 (now) and 在家 (at home)

cards.Meaning: Are you coming tomorrow or not?
cards.Notes: Verb + 不 + verb asks a yes/no question without 吗

cards.Meaning: I don't feel like going today.
cards.Notes: 想 vs 相: 想 has 心 heart underneath
